order: ten unchanged MM_xor trainings, 200 epochs maximum
presented_reader: one step on reconstruction-kept rows only
comparison_reader: one step on both compose roots, kept rows on narrowing departures
expectation_predictor: one step on reconstruction-kept rows only

identity.poles: all for coordinates followed by all against coordinates
identity.generator: private NumPy generator from first 8 bytes of SHA256(content key), little endian

certificate: all ordered vocabulary pairs including self and every sentence row; exhaustive identity-bit coverage counts; no sampling
sum_band: abs(checkerboard contrast) <= .0001, class gate not met, and abs(MSE - .25) <= .02
narrowing_credit: report counts, cost deltas and signs by proposed action, with final policy and late-window counts
